title: fix(cli): sanitize terminal escape sequences in skills library output
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes terminal control execution and forged output rows when skills-library metadata contains escape sequences or embedded line breaks.

## User Impact

Human-readable list, read, receipt, and activation metadata remains readable and safe for the terminal. Tabs and line breaks display as visible escapes. JSON retains the original metadata, and `library read` continues to print requested skill and supporting-file contents verbatim.

## Why This Change Was Made

Reuse the existing `sanitizeTerminalText` owner used by other CLI reports. Each list line is sanitized once, including the session projection, instead of wrapping every interpolated field. Mixed read output sanitizes metadata and file headers before adding the requested raw contents. The custom control-byte test scanner is removed.

Original implementation and regression by @SunnyShu0925 (SunnyShu); contributor commits are preserved.

## Evidence

- Command regressions on current main: 2 failed / 12 passed before the fix; all 14 passed with the fix. The same supported Node source/watch runner exercised the production Commander registration and stdout/JSON boundaries on both revisions.
- Coverage includes OSC/CSI/BEL, CR/LF/tab, session lists, receipts, activation output, exact JSON metadata, sanitized file headers, and unchanged raw file contents. Existing upload, connection-option, revision, and bundle tests also passed.
- Targeted oxlint, oxfmt, and diff checks passed. Independent Codex review completed with no actionable P0–P2 findings. All 14 tests passed again after integrating main (403 seconds, mostly runtime loading). [Exact-head CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/40059668933) passed on `18a33595d3f904df23b232962316389ad186cc62`.
- Production +11/-8 (net +3), tests +82, docs +4. Remaining growth is the canonical helper import and a single list-line sanitization pass; no new sanitizer or configuration is introduced.
- Retained contributor live proof at `e12c983bf1faa3d6f0e1f0aa2a9714fee44e918a`: an isolated real Gateway and shipped `skills library list` CLI with a synthetic control-bearing profile owner label went from 2 ESC / 1 BEL bytes to zero, with lossless JSON round-trip. That proof was supplied by the contributor and was not independently rerun on this revision.
- Live-test gap: no fresh authenticated Gateway was created for this revision; recreating the profile/skill fixture exceeds the scoped live-proof budget. The local regressions exercise the actual CLI formatting path, not a running Gateway.
